title: Manchester Office
h1: Not revealed by search results (link title only: "Manchester Office")
summary: Case study of a GBP 4.5m commercial mortgage arranged by Silver Oak Capital for the purchase of an office building in Manchester city centre. Borrower: a Manchester (commercial) real estate management firm that intended to complete the purchase swiftly with cash and then required immediate access to a loan post-acquisition; it wanted a long-term commercial mortgage at 65% loan-to-value. Lender: a regional lender. Structure/terms as reported: GBP 4.5m loan, 65% LTV, 7-year term, full interest-only repayment, rate of 3.00% above Bank Base Rate, 1.00% bank fee; described as tailored finance. Challenges flagged: occupancy and tenant stability as risks to rental income, and the need for thorough due diligence on compliance with modern office standards. Outcome: terms offered/arranged as above. Deal date and exact timing were not revealed by the search results.
